prompt: Spring Boot Undertow access log %D response time prerequisite
answer:
To use `%D` for response time in a Spring Boot Undertow access log, enable request start-time recording:

```properties
server.undertow.accesslog.enabled=true
server.undertow.accesslog.pattern=%t %a %r %s (%D milliseconds)
server.undertow.options.server.record-request-start-time=true
```

`server.undertow.options.server.record-request-start-time=true` is required when `%D` is included in the access-log pattern.
